switch: # Membership list of the `fixed` profile (port/test/profiles.py). Columns, tab separated:
#   switch       a sg_defect switch name as lib.defects() lists it (e.g. sinScaled.readPastTable); unknown names are an error
#   value        0 or 1 (the switch default is 1 = the original's behaviour; `fixed` lists the switches whose value differs)
#   decision_id  the lead's decision row that approved the fix (D<n> from re/roadmap/*)
#   reason       one line: the original defect the switch removes and the model_defects entry
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. The profile `original` is never listed here: it is every switch at 1.
# Filled by the S6 lead from re/port/defect_decisions.tsv rows with recommendation `fix` (D5, pre-approved: hangs and faults only).

reason: slot 127 with the byte after the table 0xff is treated as taken: the cluster loop (never ends in the original) is not entered and the link word before the table is not written
no free cell in the bank's 4 x 4 corner: return before the animal record is claimed and before any RNG draw (the original's search never ends)
a zero divisor (difficulty -4 or 4) or an empty pro roster ends the draw with pick 0 instead of raising #DE / never ending
sprite frame count 0: return before the idiv that raises #DE in the original
a tail of 0x200 or more characters (the original overwrites its return address) is refused and the text left untouched
the type-0x11 search and the clubhouse search (both never end in the original when no cell qualifies) give up: skip the feature / take the window centre

difficulty 5 or 6 (4 - difficulty < 0): once the falling acceptance bound tries / (4 - difficulty) + rep + cash is under every value the roster can give, the draw ends with pick 0 instead of never ending

the feature-site searches gated by evalPlacementArea (location 4: 2 x 2 site, kind 4; locations 5, 6, 8, 12, 13, 15: 5 x 5 site, kind 0xF) never end in the original when no reachable cell is accepted; fixed gives up and skips that feature
loadWorldAssets' tropical `Tree Cerc` / `Tree Drac` loads (the install holds Tree_Cerc / Tree_Drac) fault in the original: load the install's names instead
